lesson_additions.applicable_scope: Cross-round prediction comparisons on the same frozen case pool where canonical contexts differ or outputs reverse.
lesson_additions.brief: For same-case reversals, log both originals, observed changes, and unestablished cause; never certify model-only instability or infer causal Signal credit from equal canonical hashes.
lesson_additions.guidance: When the same frozen case yields opposite binary calls across rounds, record it as a cross-round comparison with both originals, the observed output changes, and cause_status=unestablished. Do not certify model-only instability from equal canonical contexts, and do not infer causal Signal credit from the reversal. Route context/prompt sensitivity to Plan research; treat any economic-factor explanation as a hypothesis measurable from prediction-time evidence and testable across independent cases.
limitations: Canonical hashes do not establish equal provider prompts or model parameters.
A reversal and outcome correctness do not establish a causal explanation.

lesson_additions.applicable_scope: Reading slow-loop result and validation summaries for signal promotion, validation, and magnitude-contribution status.
lesson_additions.brief: Use measurement_contract to read slow-loop summaries: NEUTRAL is available not decisive, decisive/available gaps are expected, and validated hashes show technical validity only, not verified effect.
lesson_additions.guidance: Interpret slow-loop cycle summaries using the measurement_contract: NEUTRAL is available but not decisive, so a decisive/available gap is expected and is not unexplained sample exclusion. Both arms share the frozen case pool, but availability and decisive subsets may differ with their measurements or thresholds. A promoted or validated signal hash establishes technical validity, not verified effect; magnitude contribution stays unassessed until the Fast absent/present consumption experiment and Binary-F1 protection run.
limitations: Promoted/validated hashes are technical-validity artifacts, not measured efficacy.
Magnitude contribution was not assessed in this cycle.

lesson_additions.applicable_scope: Handling rejected signal-update candidates in slow-loop validation where the failure is structural rather than substantive.
lesson_additions.brief: A structured_output_failed rejection for no effective change is a technical outcome; preserve diagnostics, require a real edit or explicit no_change/defer, and do not infer factor irrelevance.
lesson_additions.guidance: Treat a structured_output_failed rejection (e.g., a signal update whose mutable values equal the stable baseline) as a technical execution outcome, not a research conclusion about the signal's relevance. Preserve the case diagnostics and require an actual effective change or an explicit no_change/defer with candidate=null and changed_paths=[] before resubmitting. Do not convert the rejection into evidence that the underlying factor lacks predictive value.
limitations: The rejection reason is a validation message, not a measured effect on surge direction.
No substantive liquidity_runway_months edit was tested in this cycle.
